verdict.rationale: Pulley's fundraising-modeling page says it can model exit scenarios, so the product has its own capability on this axis, but the evidence is a single marketing line with no detail on how the waterfall works. missing for 10: documentation of proceeds broken out per share class and per stakeholder, comparison across multiple exit values, handling of liquidation preferences and participation (including caps), and any hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can run exit waterfall analyses showing proceeds per share class and stakeholder under different exit values, honoring preferences and participation

citations.quote: Run models for complex pre-financing, post-financing, or exit scenarios.
